title: The Haunted Nursery
intro: A rocking horse creaks without a rider. A music box plays a lullaby that does not quite fit the tune. Whatever you need is locked inside the toy chest.

objects.label: Smiling Doll
objects.reward_text: The doll's head turns and its eyes open wide.

objects.label: Spinning Top
objects.reward_text: The spirit is amused. It whispers: 'Everything in this room is connected. Finish what you started.'

a_box: Write the rule as a formula: next = previous + the one before that + a fixed extra.
Check it: 4 + 4 + 3 = 11. Keep going one generation at a time.
Generation 10 = 235 + 144 + 3 = 382. The vault's character number 1 is Q.
b_horse: Start with the clue that rules out the most positions, such as a figure at an end.
Work out which figures are certainly NOT next to each other, then try the possible arrangements.
From the left, the order begins: Butler, Heir.
The full row from the left is: Butler, Heir, Priest, Duke, Widow, Doctor. The answer is the Butler. The vault's character number 2 is X.
c_house: You need exactly (width) steps right and (height) steps up, in some order.
The number of routes is the number of ways to choose which steps are 'right'.
That is C(8, 5), the number of ways to choose 5 items from 8.
The answer is 56. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are 3 and U.
dare_top: A dare is optional and never needed to leave the floor.
It never costs you anything to skip it.
Do the dare only if you and your team are happy with it.
It never owns part of the vault code. Skip it freely.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Music Box, Rocking Horse, Doll House.
